title: Glowy Super™ Gel Gift Set

specifications.ingredientPreferences: sulfateFree, crueltyFree, nonComedogenic, siliconeFree, cleanAtSephora, parabenFree, hyaluronicAcid, oilFree, alcoholFree, fragranceFree, squalane, vegan

descriptionHtml:
✓ Clean + Planet Aware✓ Fragrance Free✓ Non-Comedogenic✓ Without Silicones✓ Radiant Finish
What it is: A gift set featuring award-winning illuminator Glowy Super™ Gel in bestselling shades Sunglow (full) and Starglow (mini) for hydrated, glowy radiance.

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Plant-Derived Glycerin: Powerful humectant known to increase skin’s natural moisture levels.
- Olive-Derived Squalane: Locks in moisture and leaves skin quenched and visibly glowing.
- Rosehip Seed Oil: Ultra-rich in antioxidants to visibly brighten and moisturize skin.

Ingredient Callouts: These products are vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This noncomedogenic illuminator is your forever first step under makeup for a glitter-free glow. Glowy Super™ Gel can be worn alone, mixed into skincare an
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Apply one to two pumps all over as your forever first step for glowing skin.
-Use fingertips or The Big Brush (sold separately) to blend in.
-Glowy Super™ Gel is also a multipurpose illuminator: Stacked on top of any look as a spot highlighter for instant glass skin; mixed into cream makeup or skincare formula to boost glow; or worn alone on the face or body (like your chest, collarbones, shoulders, and legs) for an all-over-glow.
Ingredients+
-Plant-Derived Glycerin: Powerful humectant known to increase skin’s natural moisture levels.
-Olive-Derived Squalane: Locks in moisture and leaves skin quenched and visibly glowing.
-Rosehip Seed Oil: Ultra-rich in antioxidants to visibly brighten and moisturize skin.

Aqua/Water/Eau, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Propanediol, Glycerin, Mica, Squalane, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Polysorbate 60, Sorbitan Isostearate, Phenethyl Alcohol, Caprylyl Glycol, Tocopherol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Lactic Acid. [+/- May Contain/Peut Contenir: Titanium Dioxide (Ci 77891), Iron Oxides (Ci 77491, Ci 77499)].
The list of ingredients is subject to change. Please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
